abstract: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is an aggressive and relatively uncommon disease characterized by profound dense fibrosis and late-stage diagnosis. An anthelmintic drug, Niclosamide (NIC), has been widely repurposed as an anticancer agent, but its poor aqueous solubility resulted in < 10 % oral bioavailability, while its poor lipid solubility poses substantial challenges for the development of a translational oral formulation. Herein, we have developed a self-nanoemulsifying (SNEDDS) formulation (NanoNic) that utilizes Transcutol® P as cosolvent and leverages the Hydrophobic Ion-Pairing (HIP) complexation strategy to improve drug loading and stability. To this end, we screened cationic complexing agents with different amine functionalities - primary, ternary and quaternary. Cationic ionizable lipid/DLin-DMA was selected as pairing agent based on its superior biocompatibility, complexation efficiency, and kinetic stability. Incorporation of cationic ionizable lipid forming a hydrophobic complex with NIC resulted in nearly 30 % reduction in globule size to ∼ 67 nm with a zeta potential >+35 mV. Optimized NanoNic (HIP-loaded SNEDDS) demonstrated ∼ 4-fold higher drug-loading compared to traditional SNEDDS (without a complexing agent), which showed immediate drug precipitation after redispersion. HIP-loaded NanoNic preconcentrate was stable for over 3 months, whereas its aqueous dispersion exhibited only 2 % drug precipitation within 24 h. The Quality-by-Design approach was employed to optimize the nano-globule size of the formulation/NanoNic. Furthermore, NanoNic displayed significant anti-angiogenic activity (HUVEC model) and anticancer efficacy in 2D and 3D models of naïve and gemcitabine-resistant MiaPaCa-2 spheroids. Thus, collective use of Transcutol®P and Ionizable lipid enabled self-nanoemulsifying system with high drug load, reduced globule size and high kinetic solubility.
key_points_ko: 소수성 이온 쌍 형성 기법을 접목해 기존 자가 나노유화 제형 대비 약 4배 높은 약물 탑재량을 달성했습니다.
약물 입자 크기를 약 67nm로 줄이고 수용액 분산 24시간 내 약물 침전율을 2% 수준으로 낮추어 안정성을 확보했습니다.
젬시타빈 내성을 가진 췌장암 세포주 2D 및 3D 구체 모델과 혈관신생 모델에서 우수한 항암 효과를 확인했습니다.
summary_ko: 구충제로 알려진 niclosamide(니클로사마이드)는 췌장암 항암제로 재창출 가능성이 높지만 낮은 수용해도와 경구 흡수율이 한계였습니다. 연구진은 소수성 이온 쌍 형성(HIP) 기법을 자가 나노유화 약물전달체(SNEDDS) 기술과 결합한 'NanoNic' 제형을 개발했습니다. NanoNic은 기존 제형 대비 약 4배 높은 약물 탑재량과 뛰어난 약물 안정성을 나타냈습니다. 또한 젬시타빈 내성 췌장암 세포(MiaPaCa-2) 2D 및 3D 모델에서 우수한 항암 효능과 혈관신생 억제 효과를 입증했습니다.
title: Hydrophobic ion pairing enabled self-nanoemulsifying niclosamide for pancreatic cancer: improved drug loading and kinetic solubility
title_ko: 췌장암 치료를 위한 소수성 이온 쌍 형성 기반 니클로사마이드 자가 나노유화제: 약물 탑재량 및 용해도 개선
